title: File:Surf sur la Vague de Teahupoo (Tahiti) (Ifremer 00783-89468 - 49350).jpg
art: Olivier Dugornay (IFREMER, Pôle Images, Centre Bretagne - ZI de la Pointe du Diable - CS 10070 - 29280 Plouzané, France)
desc: Teahupoo wave (Tahiti) a few kilometers from the Ifremer Pacific Center. The swell breaks on the coral reef, forming huge waves that benefit surfers. Surfing in Tahiti is both a recreational sea sport and a tradition.
